description: Ministry of Megapolis & Western Development - Order to declare the areas in Aluth Eluwankulama and Serakkuliya Grama Niladhari Divisions as an Urban Development Area
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land matters, specifically the declaration of Aluth Eluwankulama and Serakkuliya Grama Niladhari Divisions as an urban development area. It includes detailed descriptions of land boundaries, metes and bounds, and references to previously declared urban council areas and local government boundaries. While it mentions a minister's name (Patali Champika Ranawaka), this is incidental to the main purpose of the gazette, which is land development and zoning. The content fits the Land Gazette category as it concerns land use planning, development areas, and property boundary specifications.
